review_kind: informed model-assisted paper/source audit; external independent review pending
notice: No checker, solver, project tests, fixture semantic execution or native API ran. Values/flows/potentials/cuts are specified by hand.

feasible_optimum: sparse nonzero arc flow table; omitted=0
integer potential for every reconstructed node
infeasible: cut S containing s not t
all evidence retained; no closure claim

network_reconstruction.arcs: s->u cap1; allowed u->i cap1; i->t min(c_i,h); original c_i for C_T
network_reconstruction.cost_d: [u in D_P and i in T] on u->i
network_reconstruction.residual: for each original arc: forward if x<cap at +cost, reverse if x>0 at -cost; preserve arc identity
network_reconstruction.optimality: cost_res(v,w)+pi(v)-pi(w)>=0 for ALL positive-capacity residual arcs
network_reconstruction.backend_demands: source=-h, sink=+h, all others0; reject zero-flow-by-default misuse

independent_checks: rebuild full original graph from bound math input, not submitted graph
all residual arcs/potentials or full cut capacity
scope/O/history/fee and revision commit outside pure arithmetic
reject_or_unknown: unknown source cap is not zero
resource limits -> UNKNOWN_RESOURCE_LIMIT, no input truncation
unverified backend infeasible -> no conflict certificate yet
cost: O(V+M) exact integer operations plus bit-length/normalization/inputs/source checks
proof_generation_cost: if backend omits potentials, add super-source to every residual node and use mature Bellman-Ford for integer distances, O(VM); source/algorithm input binding still separate
backend_complexity_note: O(hVM) is the prior SSAP existence envelope, not a bound certified for unfrozen NetworkX network-simplex. Include extra dual/cut generation and exact selected backend/resources.
